scope: small offline synthetic and frozen-metadata audit, not new market evaluation

cases.normal: first frozen strict-panel portfolio with its original tickers
cases.mutation: replace its first ticker with a same-market accepted-H1 training ticker
cases.expected: normal allowed; mutation rejected before provider access

cases.normal: diagnostic as-of equal to the fixed decision cutoff
cases.mutation: diagnostic as-of moved to the following business day
swap two ordered feature names without changing dimensionality

cases.normal: H5 production purge/embargo split on a synthetic business-date series
cases.mutation: naive chronological split at the same raw boundary without purge/embargo
cases.detector: independent shared-realized-return-position checker in the new harness
cases.detector_origin: new audit harness; not a production import guard
cases.expected: normal has zero shared label-return positions; mutation has at least one

cases.mutation: increase one base-scenario reported realized_cost while leaving fee, spread, slippage and net returns unchanged
cases.detector: independent cost-component and net-return identity checker in the new harness
cases.detector_origin: new audit harness; not a production post-export guard
cases.expected: normal reconciles; mutated ledger is rejected

decision_rule: For each case, PASS requires normal accepted and injected error detected. Record each normal false alarm, injected miss, exception and runtime, even if the suite fails.
claim_limit: Five designed examples validate specified checks only. They do not estimate field error prevalence, independent auditor effectiveness, predictive quality, investment value or generalizability.
